note: Examples of harmful messages for the meaning check (meaning_check.py). Quoted lines are offender messages reported in the cited paper; the rest are short example phrasings of strategies the papers describe, written by Claude and marked as such. The harmless side is the phone's own messages.

sources.LDK2019: Lorenzo-Dus & Kinzel (2019), Journal of Corpora and Discourse Studies 2(1), doi:10.18573/jcads.31 (CC-BY 4.0) — offender excerpts
sources.LDK2019_MODEL: Lorenzo-Dus et al. (2016) online grooming discourse model, as described in Lorenzo-Dus & Kinzel (2019): isolation
sources.BLACK2015: Black et al. (2015), Child Abuse & Neglect 44, 140-149 — manually coded grooming strategies
sources.CG2017_18: Chiang & Grant (2017, 2018) moves, as summarised in Lorenzo-Dus & Kinzel (2019)
sources.OWNER: FFS Explorer owner's case focus (requests for images), 2026-10-25
